items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: that is, myself, Harry Carney, another fellow named Edgar McIlvaine... We can go to the Savoy Ballroom

ctx.x: Well, how we decided to come to New York, I'll tell you. There was a bunch of us, Sunday afternoons, sitting in the ice cream parlor, which was where we all hung out. All the little girls come from Sunday School and one thing or another, and all us hip boys, you know, get 15 cents so you can get an ice cream soda -- one of them things. So we used to hang in this ice cream parlor all day.

And there were about five of us sitting at a table. So one of them says, "Hey, let's get together and go to New York on the weekend." We can go to the Savoy Ballroom, and Johnny Hodges is working over there." And man, when they said Johnny Hodges was there, I was for coming. Well, four of us decided to come over here; that is, myself, Harry Carney, another fellow named Edgar McIlvaine...
